name: stillfield
description: A tranquil farming and zen garden playground for iPhone, iPad, and web.
author: John Karakelle

scripts.build: tsc && npm run icons && vite build && node scripts/build-sw.mjs
scripts.ios:build: DEVELOPER_DIR=${DEVELOPER_DIR:-/Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer} xcodebuild -project ios/Stillfield.xcodeproj -scheme Stillfield -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' -derivedDataPath ios/.build build CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO
scripts.ios:test-ui: DEVELOPER_DIR=${DEVELOPER_DIR:-/Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer} xcodebuild -project ios/Stillfield.xcodeproj -scheme Stillfield -derivedDataPath ios/.build test CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO
